CURSEFORGE_TOKEN.description: CurseForge API Token to publish builds straight from your IDE. [Read their API Documentation](https://support.curseforge.com/en/support/solutions/articles/9000197321-curseforge-api)

DEV_USERNAME.description: Can be used to set the player name

MAVEN_USERNAME.description: Name used to upload files to the Maven specified by `maven_url`

MODRINTH_TOKEN.description: Modrinth API Token to publish builds straight from your IDE. The token must have the `CREATE_VERSION` and `PROJECT_WRITE` permissions. [Read their API Documentaion](https://docs.modrinth.com/)

access_transformer_location.description: Change location and name of the AT file

additional_dependencies.description: Project names that should be added as 'required'. Mods with build-in integration except the ones from `dependencies.properties` are taken care of automatically.

coremod_includes_mod.description: Change to false if your coremod doesn't have a `@Mod` annotation

coremod_plugin_class_name.description: You MUST state a class name if you are making a coremod, the class should implement `IFMLLoadingPlugin`

curseforge_debug.description: Enable debug mode. Simulating a file upload, without actually pushing anything.

curseforge_id.description: CurseForge project ID must be the numerical ID and not the slug

disable_editorconfig.description: Use this to prevent the buildscripts from overriding your `.editorconfig` file

disable_spotless.description: Spotless is a code formatting plugin that can enforce a consistent code style across your project. [Documentation](https://github.com/diffplug/spotless/tree/main/plugin-gradle)

extra_jvm_args.description: Additional arguments applied to the JVM when launching minecraft. Syntax: `-arg1=value1;-arg2=value2;...`

generate_javadocs_jar.description: If true, Gradle will also generate a Javadocs jar whenever you build your project.

generate_mixin_json.description: Generate missing configs from `mixin_configs` (full resource filenames, e.g. `mixins.modid.config_name.json`)

generate_source_jar.description: If true, Gradle will also generate a sources jar whenever you build your project.

grs_disable_cache.description: Should GroovyScript cache changes to improve load time?

grs_generate_and_crash.description: Should the game crash after generating the wiki page and/or example scripts?

grs_generate_examples.description: Should example scripts from other loaded mods be generated in the 'examples' folder?

grs_generate_wiki.description: Should the corresponding wiki page be generated when executing the 'runClient' task?

grs_log_missing_lang_keys.description: Should missing language keys be logged to the mod log?

grs_run_ls.description: Should the GroovyScript language server be run when executing the 'runClient' task?

grs_use_examples_folder.description: Instead of using the GroovyScript folder in run/groovyscript, use the 'examples' folder instead.

is_client_side.description: Set to false if your mod is server-side only. Used to set environment on CurseForge and Modrinth.

is_coremod.description: The most powerful way to change java classes at runtime, it is however very primitive with little documentation. Only make a coremod if you are absolutely sure of what you are doing.

is_server_side.description: Set to false if your mod is client-side only. Used to set environment on CurseForge and Modrinth.

license.description: The license this project is published under.

maven_name.description: The name of the file you want to publish

maven_url.description: URL of the maven you want to publish on

minecraft_username.description: This can also be set via the `DEV_USERNAME` variable.

minecraft_version.description: The version of Minecraft to use. This should only ever be `1.12.2` and changing this may lead to unexpected issues.

mixin_configs.description: Delimit configs with spaces. Template generation can be toggled via `generate_mixins_json`

mixin_connector_class.description: Classpath to fully-qualified class implementing `org.spongepowered.asm.mixin.connect.IMixinConnector`. When non-empty, written to the jar manifest as MixinConnector

mixin_refmap.description: A refmap is a JSON that denotes mapping conversions, this JSON is generated automatically, with the name `mixins.mod_id.refmap.json`

mod_authors.description: Authors of the mod. Separate multiple authors with commas.

mod_description.description: A short description of your mod.

mod_id.description: The mod id is a unique identifier for your mod. It must be all lowercase and contain no spaces.

mod_logo_path.description: The logo path for the mod. This should be a path to a PNG file within the assets folder of your mod.

mod_name.description: The mod name is the display name for your mod. This can contain spaces and capitalization.

mod_url.description: The URL to the homepage of the mod or its git repository.

modrinth_debug.description: Enable debug mode. Simulating a file upload, without actually pushing anything.

modrinth_id.description: The Modrinth ID of your project

modrinth_sync_readme.description: Allows Gradle to sync the README.md to the Modrinth project body

osxnarratorblocker_version.description: Provided by the template via `gradle.properties`. Blocks the narrator for M1+ Macs to prevent crashes and issues.

partnership.description:
A section about a partnership if there is one to promote. Use `
` for linebreak. An example can be found in the `project.properties`.

publish_to_curseforge.description: Enable features related to publishing to CurseForge

publish_to_modrinth.description: Enable features related to publishing to Modrinth

readme.description:
A longer description about the features of this mod. Use `
` for linebreak. An example can be found in the `project.properties`.

root_package.description: The root package for your mod's main class. Change this to your own package. This should match the directory structure of your main class.

strip_latest_forge_requirements_version.description: Provided by the template via `gradle.properties`. Saves everyone a hassle when it comes to depending on mods, which require the _latest_ forge version.

tag_class_name.description: The path where the generated Tags class will be placed. Separators should be dots, e.g. `com.example.project`

use_access_transformer.description: A way to change visibility of Minecraft's classes, methods and fields. AT files should be in the root of src/main/resources with the filename formatted as: `${mod_id}_at.cfg`

use_assetmover.description: Convenient way to allow downloading of assets from official vanilla Minecraft servers, CurseForge, or any direct links. Also check the [Documentation](https://github.com/CleanroomMC/AssetMover).

use_betterconfig.description: BetterConfig extends Forge's annotation-based config system to support nested arrays, collections, arrays/collections/maps of objects, and much more. Also check the [Documentation](https://github.com/Meldexun/BetterConfig/blob/main/README.md)

use_catalyx.description: Kotlin library by [Ender-Development.org](https://ender-development.org) that provides various utilities and helpers for Minecraft Forge modding

use_configanytime.description: Allows Forge configurations to be setup at any point in time

use_crafttweaker.description: Allows modpack creators to change recipes and other game objects via [ZenScript](https://github.com/CraftTweaker/ZenScript)

use_dependency_at_files.description: If true, dependencies will be scanned for AT files and applied automatically

use_expandedevents.description: It adds a number of new event handlers to Minecraft. Aimed at developers who want to access these methods without needing to write mixins every time. See [Documentation](https://github.com/Invadermonky/ExpandedEvents/wiki)

use_forgelincontinuous.description: A library that provides Kotlin support for Minecraft Forge mods. Automatically enabled, when your project is written in Kotlin or you are using Catalyx.

use_groovyscript.description: Allows modpack creators to change recipes and other game objects via [Groovy](https://github.com/apache/groovy)

use_kotlin.description: Use Kotlin as a language instead of Java.

use_mixins.description: Powerful tool to do runtime description changes of classes. Docs: [SpongeForge Wiki](https://github.com/SpongePowered/Mixin/wiki), [MixinBooter Wiki](https://github.com/CleanroomMC/MixinBooter), [CleanroomMC Wiki](https://cleanroommc.com/wiki/forge-mod-development/mixin/preface)

use_modularui.description: A GUI library to ease the process of creating vanilla style GUIs. Docs: [CleanroomMC Wiki](https://cleanroommc.com/wiki/modularui/introduction#modularui)

use_reachfix.description: Fix for vanillas hit detection and the reach attribute not being used for entities. Provides utils when working with player reach.

use_tags.description: A class is generated at build-time for compilation, to describe property that have values that could change at build time such as versioning. Java uses the RetroFuturaGradle implementation, while Kotlin uses a dynamically generated class.
